Initial release of dlazy-seedream-5.0-lite

- Provides fast image generation via Doubao Seedream 5.0 Lite.
- Supports both text-to-image and image-to-image conversion.
- Command-line tool with flexible options for prompt, images, resolution, and size.
- Includes error handling for authentication, missing parameters, file errors, and balance/credit issues.
- Output delivers generated image URLs in a standardized JSON format.
- User guidance included for resolving API key and balance-related errors.
